input: We are sending SGI 5 from CPU0 to CPU3. The SGI is sent by writing to ICC_SGI1R_EL1 with the target affinity of CPU3. However the interrupt arrives on CPU0 instead. The platform uses GIC-600 with banked SGI registers. What could cause the SGI to target the wrong CPU and how do I decode the ICC_SGI1R_EL1 affinity fields correctly for multi-cluster topologies?
